name: Mattress and sofa cleaning
summary: How expats book mattress and sofa cleaning in Singapore for humidity, dust mites, and rental turnover — including what steam/chemical methods can and cannot fix before you blame mould on the unit alone.
body:
Humid flats and daily air-con cycles load sofas and mattresses with dust mites, spills, and odours. Professional upholstery cleaning is a common pre-guest or mid-lease reset — distinct from end-of-lease domestic cleaning.

## Typical services
- Mattress deep clean and sanitise
- Fabric sofa shampoo / extraction
- Leather conditioning (different skillset)
- Stain treatment with realistic expectations
- Optional waterproof mattress protectors after cleaning

Photos of “before/after” stains help set scope; some dye transfers never fully reverse.

## Rental angles
Landlords may dispute wear vs damage — dated photos after cleaning help. If mould patterns track from walls/windows, cleaning fabric alone will not solve the building moisture problem; pair with the mould/humidity rental habits.

## How to choose
Prefer operators who explain dry-time, chemical sensitivities (asthma/kids/pets), and whether cushions are cleaned in place. Get written quotes per seat and mattress size. Avoid same-day upsells into full-home packages you did not request.

## Practical tip
Open windows or run ventilation during dry-down when weather allows — trapping wet fabric in sealed air-con rooms invites musty rebound overnight.
